checkpoint_selection: Smallest mean validation cross-entropy after an epoch; earliest epoch wins exact ties. Never evaluate test/challenge during fit.
determinism: Seed Python, NumPy and torch; deterministic torch algorithms; seeded independent shuffle generator; CPU float32. Reproduce full training once; report discrepancies rather than promising cross-platform bit equality.
evaluation: Compare frozen baseline v2 and selected transformer on identical 423 historical benchmark and 2000 challenge inputs. Freeze model/threshold before scoring. Report class metrics, FPR, balanced accuracy, source/origin subgroups, paired correctness, whole-group 1000-resample seed-42 intervals, token truncation and resource conditions. Current benchmarks are already inspected; final reserve is not used.
optimizer: AdamW; decay weights except bias and LayerNorm.weight. All encoder/head parameters train.
post_score_review: Review deterministic capped false-positive/false-negative and correct-control samples only after selection and scoring; record observations without retuning.
reproduction: Repeat training and benchmark scoring once under the unchanged protocol; independent counts and artifact integrity. No stage 6.
schedule: Linear warmup then linear decay to zero; one fixed configuration and seed, no hyperparameter search.
text: Use frozen real-mail-v2 subject/body and baseline marker removal; fixed uncased WordPiece tokenizer. Right truncate including special tokens, dynamic batch padding; record all truncation counts. No row dropped for length after the existing character contract.
threshold_selection: At the selected checkpoint use the unchanged baseline validation-only phishing-F1 grid and ties. Report fixed 0.50 as a prespecified diagnostic. No adjustment after benchmark results.
